mapper.select: SELECT `character`.*, `creation_record`.action_timestamp as creation_timestamp, `modification_record`.action_timestamp as modification_timestamp, `creation_record`.user_name as creator, `creation_record`.role_name, `creation_record`.role_id FROM `character` JOIN `action_lineage` as creation_record on creation_record.id = `character`.creation_record_id JOIN `action_lineage` as modification_record on modification_record.id = `character`.modification_record_id LEFT JOIN `character_type` on `character`.`id` = `character_type`.`character_id` LEFT JOIN `haki` on `character`.id = haki.character_id LEFT JOIN `character_to_fruit` on `character`.id = character_to_fruit.character_id WHERE `character`.id = #{id} GROUP BY `character`.`id`
